model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the average performance across five datasets—NQ, TQA, zsRE, T-rex, and HQA—measured in performance units. The horizontal axis represents the datasets, presented in left-to-right order, and the vertical axis displays the average performance, ranging from 0 to 60, with tick marks indicating intervals of 10. The value axis is linear and labeled “Average Performance”. Three bars are displayed, with blue bars representing performance “With Context” and purple bars representing performance “Without Context”. The “With Context” bar, located to the left, reaches approximately 57 on the vertical axis, while the “Without Context” bar, located to the right, reaches approximately 43. The ‘Standard’ bar is shown as a single, solid blue circle, and the “ClinGS (w/)” and “ClinGS” bars are portrayed as a cluster of small, red circles of uniform height.
